slot_scores.name: no_borrowing_cash_only
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there any constraint on the total amount you can invest across all products in a given year, or is the only limit the cash available at the beginning of that year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether the only limit is cash available at the beginning of the year, which touches the cash-only funding restriction, but did not explicitly ask whether borrowing or loans are allowed.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Borrowing is not allowed and investments must be funded only by cash on hand from initial capital and matured proceeds.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly asked whether borrowing or loans were permitted; it only asked about cash availability limits, so the no-borrowing constraint was not directly confirmed.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped after many repetitive questions without explicitly resolving the P1 no-borrowing/cash-only constraint.

summary: The agent asked many repetitive and low-value questions about zero-investment options and product availability, but only partially addressed the key no-borrowing/cash-only constraint and never explicitly confirmed whether borrowing was allowed.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
